verse.verse_1: By the pluckers (the angels of death), violently plucking (the souls of the unbelievers),
verse.verse_2: by the drawers (the angels of death), gently drawing (the souls of the believers),
verse.verse_6: On the Day, the shiverer shivers
verse.verse_8: hearts will throb on that Day
verse.verse_9: and their eyes will be humbled.
verse.verse_10: They say: 'What, are we being restored as we were before,
verse.verse_11: even after we are fragmented bones'
verse.verse_12: They will say: 'Then we are returned lost'
verse.verse_13: But it will be only a single blow,
verse.verse_14: and they will be upon the surface of the earth (alive).
verse.verse_15: Have you received the story of Moses?
verse.verse_16: His Lord called to him in the Sacred Valley of Towa,
verse.verse_17: saying 'Go to Pharaoh, he has become exceedingly insolent,
verse.verse_19: that I might guide you to your Lord, so that you fear (Him)."
verse.verse_20: He showed him the mighty sign,
verse.verse_23: then, he gathered, proclaimed, then said:
verse.verse_24: 'I am your lord, the most high'
verse.verse_25: So Allah seized him with the punishment of the Everlasting Life, and of this world.
verse.verse_26: Surely, in this there is a lesson for he that fears!
verse.verse_27: What, are you harder to create than the heaven which He has built?
verse.verse_28: He raised it high and leveled it,
verse.verse_29: and darkened its night and brought forth its morning.
verse.verse_30: And the earth He extended after that;
verse.verse_31: and then brought from it its water and pastures.
verse.verse_32: And the mountains He set firm
verse.verse_33: an enjoyment for you and your herds.
verse.verse_34: But when the Great Catastrophe comes,
verse.verse_35: the Day when the human will remember what he has worked for,
verse.verse_36: and when Hell is advanced for whoever sees,
verse.verse_37: then as for whosoever was insolent
verse.verse_39: surely, Hell will be their refuge.
verse.verse_40: But, whosoever feared the standing before his Lord and prevented the self from desires,
verse.verse_41: indeed, their refuge shall be Paradise.
verse.verse_42: They will question you about the Hour: 'When shall it be'
verse.verse_43: But how are you to know?
verse.verse_44: Its final end is for your Lord.
verse.verse_45: You are but a warner for those who fear it.
verse.verse_46: On the Day when they behold it, it will be as if they had lingered but an evening, or, a morning.
